verdict.rationale: n8n's self-hosted model means users own their database directly, workflows are portable as JSON, source control/Git integration (n8n-docs-22) and the n8n API (n8n-docs-16) allow programmatic extraction of workflow data, and community members confirm long-term self-hosting with full data control (n8n-comm-1, n8n-comm-16). However, this is 'fair-code' not fully open-source (n8n-comm-19 explicitly notes 'not really OSS'), and there is no explicit documented bulk data-export feature or open-format guarantee beyond workflow JSON/git. Missing for 10: explicit documented full-data-export tooling/guide, clarity on execution-history export format, and independent confirmation of a clean 'leave' migration path.
